title: Independent zero-network audit of bounded two-wallet single-wallet transport live re-smoke
objective: Independently audit the bounded post-repair live re-smoke evidence. Require exactly four single-wallet invocations, two identities each with 7d and 30d parseable PARTIAL or MAPPED records, clean sanitized outputs, and no budget or security violation. No live requests.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue network, provider, or GMGN CLI requests.
Do not read credentials, plaintext addresses, labels, raw payloads, raw stdout/stderr, proxy URLs, or complete exceptions.
Do not modify application code, tests, live output, or implementer report.
Do not authorize full rerun unless every wallet-period observation is identity-bound and PARTIAL or MAPPED.
